limitations: This is an evidence limitation, not a finding that AGI had been achieved.

our_interpretation: Assess the publicly established state of capability at publication, using June 4–5, 2026 as the reporting snapshot supplied by the surrounding discussion.

A failure by Claude alone cannot establish that no other system met this definition.
